diagnosis.symptom: Two child powershell exits2 before first WPF Accounts assertion.
diagnosis.measuredCause: Fixture invoked async WPF actions with SynchronizationContext.Current null before a dispatcher frame. Windows Error Reporting identifies Dispatcher.VerifyAccess; diagnostic v3 shows thread14 context=null at toggle and dispatcher wait.
diagnosis.fix: Maintained fixture installs DispatcherSynchronizationContext before native actions, matching production Application.Run. Stage, required-control and thread-access diagnostics remain in the real native test fixture.
diagnosis.alternative: Invalid WPF control tree or account bridge payload.
diagnosis.actualObservation: Unchanged production source passed all16 after the fixture context changed; named controls found and every account action/failure assertion passed.
